column2: ...What is it...? I've got a bad feeling...
Yeah. The others are sound asleep in their rooms. But me...\n\n...after what happened, how could I sleep...?
It's fine. No need to apologize.\n\nMaria is inside me, after all...
Looks like they're both sleeping like logs.
It was a rough day for Shusha. And Tomisaburo's huge snoring is nothing new!
I just have a bad feeling...
Becoming one with Maria seems to have given me the power of precognition.
Maybe... Want to go take a look outside?
What's up, this late at night?
I've got a bad feeling... so I thought I'd...
A bad feeling...? I'll come too.
Is that the remains of the Ma? Looks like my bad hunch was right!
The black moon is out!!\n\n...Is the black moon bringing the Ma back to life!?
Is the black moon bringing the Ma back to life!?
Watch out! They're coming at us!
Are those people possessed by the Ma? Did the Ma that came off me get into them!?
No, it's the black moon controlling them! That's what I think!
I agree. These people are being controlled by the black moon!
Thank goodness, they're just knocked out!
Couldn't there be others being controlled?
There aren't enough of us alone.\n\nLet's wake up our friends while we look for the people being controlled.
Akira-kun! Jack! Mondo-san! Ryoma-san! Yamagishi-kun! Fukurokoji-kun! Enma-kun! Kapaeru! Great King Enma-sama! Jiro-kun! Goki! Senki! Koji-kun! Boss! Mucha! Nuke! Goda-kun! Uryu-san!
Damn! Looks like they're being controlled!
Even our friends are being controlled...!
...That's {s}'s voice!? It came from upstairs! {s}'s room is on the upper floor! Hurry!
Jubei? Princess Yukiko? Miyuki-san? Sayaka-san? Mitsurugi-san?
What on earth is going on?
But even our friends are being controlled! There's nowhere to run, is there?
It looks like the remains of the Ma came back to life...
Right now, finding somewhere to run comes first. Some of our friends might still be safe.
It's okay, I'll... we'll protect you!
No good here. Let's find another way...!
We are... envoys of the black moon...
The Moon of destruction... where is it?
The Sun of rebirth... where is it?
The black moon desires... It commands us... to search...
You two! Don't just stand there!
It's no use, {p}! We'll have to fight and knock them out!
There's no guarantee they'll go back to normal if we knock them out, though.
I know. Even so, we gotta fight!
I... I have at last! At last I've obtained it! The Moon of destruction...!!
...Why am I in a place like this...?
...My head feels like it's... splitting...!\n\nHuh? Is that... a monster!?
